raw_record_array.semantic_fields: unknown four raw DWORDs; no inferred rectangle/material/texture ownership
raw_record_array.reserve: Signed requested minimum1; if greater than capacity allocate wrapped requested<<4. Copy records as ordered DWORD operations with live input pointer/count after allocator, free old storage, then publish pointer/capacity.
raw_record_array.resize: Reserve only as needed; initialize new records as four zero DWORD stores; shrinking only repeatedly decrements count; store requested count at end.
raw_record_array.append: At equality grow with signed wrapped doubling and minimum1. Resolve destination after reserve. Copy input DWORDs in order if destination nonzero, then count++. Input must remain valid across any reserve.
raw_record_array.destruction: Resize zero and free current storage. No element destructors and no reset of pointer/capacity.
raw_record_array.valid_host_domain: nonnegative count<=capacity; readable/writable records; Win32 allocation and pointer arithmetic without wrap; source pointer not invalidated by reserve
